notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 – Tent Trouble Hotfix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p] Version 1.1 of [b]Toni Island Adventure[/b] launched yesterday, but we quickly found a bug that caused Toni to become invisible when entering his tent. This patch fixes the issue.[/p][p]We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, especially to those who may have lost their save files with the last update. Thanks again for your patience and support![/p][p][b]If you run into any bugs, typos, or other issues, feel free to email us at hello@frolicstudio.fun.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]– Guigo 🐾[/b][/p][p]Game Dev, Frolic Studio[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Upcoming Patch - Toni Island Adventure v1.1 Arrives August 6
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing [b]Toni Island Adventure[/b] and for all the feedback we've received so far. We're currently working on the game's first patch, which will be released on August 6.[/p][p]This update focuses on fixing bugs and making the experience smoother, especially for [b]Steam Deck[/b] players.[/p][p][b]If you run into any bugs, typos, or other issues, feel free to email us at hello@frolicstudio.fun.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]✅ What to Expect in v1.1:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]The Game Boy ROM file will be included with the game files[/p][/*][*][p]Improved control rebinding support for the Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the stick NPC in Bauport that could cause Toni to get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Increased invulnerability frames after getting hit • Fixed typos and text issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with a pizza delivery NPC that could stop progress in that quest[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out some hiccups in the last dungeon’s platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause the final boss to break in some situations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚠️ Important Save File Warning:[/h3][p]Due to memory limitations from the Game Boy hardware, [b]save files from version 1.0 will not work properly in version 1.1[/b]. If you want to keep your save or continue playing the original version, please back up your save file somewhere outside of the Steam folder before the update goes live (08/06).[/p][p][/p][h3]🔍 Known Issues (Engine-related):[/h3][p]These issues come from the game engine and not from the game itself, but we’re doing our best to improve them.[/p][list][*][p]Screen tearing and stuttering on high refresh rate monitors, especially on Windows[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🔧 What's Next?[/h3][p]This patch should cover most of the important issues. We don’t plan to release frequent updates, but we will release a new patch if a major bug is found or something threatens player progress.

[b]We’re also planning to add Steam achievements to the game.[/b] Since this requires some low-level programming work, it may arrive after this patch. That said, this addition won’t affect your save file, as it doesn’t involve changes to the game data itself.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being part of the launch and for all your support and understanding.[/p][p]I'm really proud of this little game and happy to keep improving it with your help.[/p][p][/p][p]– Guigo 🐾
[b]Game Dev, Frolic Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a brand new version of the Toni Island Adventure demo — and it’s packed with exciting updates!

The game now runs on a Godot-based engine, which significantly reduces file size and should offer better performance on PC. This update also expands your journey beyond the Pawssport checkpoint — you'll now be able to explore [b]Pomodorino Woods[/b] and venture up to [b]Mt. Stracciatella[/b], home of the mysterious [b]Oracle[/b].

Back in Bauport, a new building has appeared: the [b]Community Museum[/b], ready to be filled with the rarest gems and fish you can find later in game. And yes, the PawPhone is now fully functional, so you can make calls — a feature previously unavailable!

We’ve also addressed various bugs, fixed typos, and added small improvements throughout the game.

We hope you enjoy re-visiting Salamino Island one last time before the official launch — [strike]which is very close and should be announced soon[/strike] 👀🐾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949126/264c5864bd0c2e165dd680d1f31fc173ccddcfea.png[/img]

[b]🛠️ Changelog – Demo Update[/b]

[list]
[*] Game now runs on Godot
[*] Added character portraits to the opening cutscene
[*] Minor text edits in the opening cutscene
[*] Added new animations in the opening cutscene
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] Fixed various misspelled texts
[*] Added the Colossal Pizza to the first dungeon
[*] New NPC in Bauport: The Mayor’s Secretary
[*] The PawPhone can now make calls
[*] New NPC in Marianara Beach: Tere (backer character)
[/list]

notes.title: Toni Island Adventure Demo Update: Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hola, Guau-migos! Toni Island Adventure’s demo is back, and we’ve made some exciting updates to make your journey even better! Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]New Language Option[/b]

[b]Hola Guau-migos!:[/b] You can now experience Toni's adventure in Spanish (LATAM)!

[*] [b]Improved Exploration[/b]

[b]Paw-tographers at work:[/b] Our canine cartographers had a ruff time re-mapping the island! Check out the new and improved map in your PawPhone’s map app next time you explore.

[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancements[/b]

[b]What does this button do?:[/b] Buttons in dungeons now have clearer sprites to make them more understandable.
[b]New HUD and Stats Screen:[/b] We’ve given our HUD and stats screen a fresh coat of paint with some cosmetic updates!

[*] Bug Fixes & Adjustments

[b]Typos: [/b]We’ve tackled those pesky typos in the English language version. If you spot any remaining issues, let us know at help@frolicstudio.fun!
[b]Pesky Bugs:[/b] Fixed a bug where players wouldn’t fall into holes if they had exactly 1 HP remaining.

[/list]

notes.title: ⚙️ Patch v1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes v1.0.5[/h1]

[list] [*] [b]Adjustments in the Ancient Ruins of BauBau:[/b] It is no longer possible to get stuck, either accidentally or intentionally, on the rocks.
[*] [b]Reset of 'sokoban' puzzles:[/b] Now, when pressing 'start', the player will return to the beginning of the challenge.
[*] [b]NPC in the Ruins:[/b] The lost NPC now provides clear explanations on how to reset the puzzles if the player gets stuck.
[*] [b]Improved inventory performance:[/b] Considerable reduction in response time, providing a smoother experience.
[*] [b]Correction of typos:[/b] Minor errors have been fixed to improve text clarity. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949126/495c84b6d00778b1d3383e3e02c864560f8cf17d.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4 ⚙️
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes v1.0.4
[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game viewport is now 2x larger! You can appreciate every pixel of the adventure.

[h2]Thank you very much for your collaboration and feedback!
[/h2]

Thanks to your help, we are making the Demo experience smoother and more enjoyable for everyone!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 ⚙️
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch v1.0.3 notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made the keyboard irresponsive if the caps lock key was active
[*] Fixed a bug that made Toni's sprite invisible by The Ancient Ruins of BauBau entrance, at night
[*] The amount of BUCKS is now being shown in the correct place in the Stats window

[h2]Thank you for your input and feedback, everyone!
[/h2]

Thanks to your reports we've been able to address these minor issues and make the demo experience as smooth as possible!

notes.title: Free Demo version now available.
notes.notes:
[h1]Make room for a slice![/h1]

Toni Island Adventure's free demo version was launched this Thursday (09/27) and will be playable on Steam until November 10th.
Explore the first minutes of our pizza-eater canine hero's journey, but don't forget to make room for the full feast coming in Q1 2025!
We're thrilled and excited to be able to share a small piece of what we've been cooking until now.

Please feel free to tell us what you think about the game, share suggestions, and report any bugs/errors you may eventually encounter during your playtime through the form found at the end of the game's main menu. 

We hope you enjoy your time at Salamino Island!
